steps.name: role-suffix-and-component
steps.summary: usecase/ 7개 클래스 ...Service→...UseCase 리네임 + @Service→@Component 전환, cart/service/ 2개 Processor→Service 리네임 + @Component→@Service 전환, 모든 참조처(application/presentation/infrastructure/security/test) 업데이트 완료. test/integrationTest AC 통과.

steps.name: class-tx-to-method
steps.summary: ProductQueryService/AdminStockService/StockConcurrencyService/StockInventoryService 4개 클래스의 class-level @Transactional(readOnly = true) 제거. ProductQueryService 2개·AdminStockService 1개 조회 메서드에 method-level @Transactional(readOnly = true) 명시. ArchUnit noClassLevelTransactionalInApplication 규칙 추가 (ADR-021, ADR-L2). test/integrationTest AC 통과.

steps.name: orchestrator-to-usecase
steps.summary: AuthSignUpService/StockRestoreOutboxRelayService → usecase/ 이동 후 ...UseCase 리네임 + @Service→@Component + @Transactional 제거. OrderCreateService → OrderCreateUseCase(usecase/) + OrderCreateProcessor → OrderCreateService(service/) 분리. OutboxService 삭제 후 OrderExpirationService가 StockRestoreOutboxCreateService 직접 주입. ArchUnit usecase/service 패키지 접미사 규칙 추가(areTopLevelClasses 한정). 모든 참조처·테스트 파일 동기화. test/integrationTest/batchTest AC 통과.
